Unwind with the enchanting evening ragas of Hariprasad Chaurasia. Featuring the soulful Raga Mishra Khamaj, this audio jukebox blends serenity, romance, and the timeless beauty of Indian classical music, perfect for peaceful evenings and soulful reflections.
Credits:
Song - Raga Mishra Khamaj
Singer - Hariprasad Chaurasia
